asr.full_text: Greetings! I'm Latika Nimbalkar Welcome to my Channel Today, we will be cooking a dish of eggs which is best served with Jhanjhani For that we have boiled 6 eggs we have taken Cucumber we have taken a cup of Garlic We have also roasted half bowl of Dried Coconut No need to roast it more, only just a little We have taken 1 inch Ginger we have roasted 1 very small size Onion No need to roast it till it is too red. I have taken 1.5 tsp cumin seeds. I have also roasted 1 tsp coriander seeds. And I have roasted 1 tsp white sesame seeds. We have to grind all these spices in a mixer. But we don't have to use water at all. I have grinded the spices finely. We don't have to use water at all. We have to grind it finely. I have kept the top hot. Add some oil in it. You can add oil as per your taste. As per your taste. You can add can add oil as per your requirement. You can add more or less if you like. Add 2 bay leaves. Add chopped onions finely. If you haven't added onion on the masala, it will turn out like this. Even if you have not chopped it bit at a time we need to be careful Now we are going to saute this Roast the onions properly because our masala is still in the process We have put 3 dishes of Haldi recipe in our recipe and in the recipe To mix the Masala well it makes everything easy It is always better to cook it in the same oil if you put little bit oil then it would turn out in a nice color Now we shall fry all of them for a minute Now fry it for 1 more minute Stir it again Add chopped Tam Bata Add tam bata Add tam bata Stir it again Stir it again Add masala Add masala The flame is medium, add in the kolhapuri masala You can avoid as per personal preference Mix well Now I will reduce the flame Add half a spoon garam masala powder Stir and cook well Add some ground raw eggs Add little by little As the eggs. What happens is, the masala will get added in small amounts as well and the dish will be more tasty. Add salt to taste. And now we are going to fry the eggs. Fry them lightly, so that the eggs are not ready. I have fried the eggs, and now we are going to add lukewarm water in it. Now add the required amount of water. We are going to mix it now. Pour the water as per requirement Mix it well Please boil it with 2 in a pan The egg is nicely cooked If you want thinner then still thin You will get a one no nice taste If you like this recipe then like, comment, subscribe and share
